How We Work  /  Engagement Models

Four ways to work with us.

How engagements are shaped

Ad hoc advising

An hour or a day of our attention, for when you need a second opinion more than you need a project.

  • Sitting in on a vendor pitch and telling you afterward what you actually heard
  • Briefing a board on what AI will and will not do for a nonprofit
  • A review of a quote from another vendor before you sign it

Hourly · no commitment

Packages

A known piece of work at a known price, so you can say yes without a scoping exercise first.

  • A one-day AI bootcamp for your staff
  • A six-week prototype sprint
  • A technology assessment written up for a board or a funder

Fixed scope · fixed price

Project work

A scoped engagement to solve a specific problem or chase a specific opportunity, with a defined start, a defined finish, and a price agreed before anyone starts working.

  • Reviewing your data ecosystem and writing up what to fix first
  • Automating a client intake workflow end to end
  • A migration, a website rebuild, or a buildout, scoped and quoted up front

Scoped · flat fee

Retainer

Ongoing support on a recurring basis from someone who already knows your setup. We work with you to craft custom SLAs that fit your needs — tell us what response times you need and we'll make it happen, whether that's four-hour response for a critical system or next-business-day for advisory support.

  • Fractional CIO for an organization too small to hire one outright
  • Continuing technical support for your staff
  • A recurring advisory hour with whoever makes the decisions

Ongoing · monthly

What it costs

Every engagement is quoted in writing before it starts, whichever shape it takes. Discounts for nonprofits and for underrepresented-led businesses are built into that number, and public sector work follows the applicable schedule or solicitation.

Many clients start with a package or a single project and move to a retainer once they know what they need. That is usually the cheapest arrangement for them, and the most useful one for us.

The point is to solve the problem in front of you, not to run up hours — so tell us what you are dealing with on the first call, and we will tell you what it will cost.

Access & discounts

We care what this costs you.

A discount for nonprofits and for underrepresented-led businesses, incentives across Maine, and a limited number of pro bono hours. Discounts do not stack — if more than one applies, you get the better of the two.

See what applies to you

How we handle the paperwork

Initial scoping on us

We invest the time up front to work out what you actually need, so that when you are ready to spend money with us, you spend it on the right thing.

No charge

Clear contracts and invoices

You know what you are signing and what you are paying for. Transparency is the point, not a courtesy.

In writing

Compliance built in

We work with you to make sure what we deliver meets whatever compliance or funder requirements you answer to.

Not an add-on

Maine technology consulting for small businesses, nonprofits, startups, and public agencies.
